scope: Original frozen simulations, original observed inputs, original focal registry and original evaluation semantics. No TEST data or truth. Parent agent owns registration and any launch.
comparators: Current frozen TreeLoom architecture with exact qualified optimized execution.
TreeLoom-Transport at d=32, two rounds, 29315 parameters; disclose 32132-parameter original comparator rather than implying exact capacity matching.
fair_start: Accuracy comparison must use fresh initialization and the same registered TRAIN parent order, optimizer recipe, training exposure, VAL cadence and stopping rule for both architectures. A fresh candidate cannot be judged against a 94-update baseline continuation as a matched training experiment. Exact resumed checkpoints remain useful for execution-only profiling.
qualification_before_accuracy: Pin source, input manifest, parameter shapes and configuration before labels are joined.

Validate a complete original parent on CPU/bounded device execution, retaining all intervals and sample identities. Implement and test whole-parent bidirectional block carry and backward equivalence before relying on chunking.

Use a bounded diagnostic with the original TRAIN focal pairs and actual TRAIN labels only after root registers it. Check every parameter gradient, optimizer state, finite loss and target join lineage.
Measure end-to-end update time and peak RAM/device memory under the same thread count, device isolation and resource budget; report cold preparation and warmed updates separately.

accuracy_design.paired_seed_policy: Three predeclared paired seeds initially; if additional seeds or tuning are admitted, register them before outcomes are inspected.
accuracy_design.fixed_exposure: Same original parents/focals and optimizer-update count; report validation versus updates and examples.
accuracy_design.fixed_wall_time: Separate wall-time-budget comparison under the same resource budget and observation preparation policy; report validation versus elapsed time.
metrics: Original primary LAI metric and original weighting over samples, focals and parents.
Per-ancestry metrics and macro metric to expose class-specific regressions.
Existing calibrated loss/confidence metric when already part of the registered evaluation.
Boundary metrics only on originally authorized dense support with a frozen evaluator; sparse focal labels alone cannot establish dense boundary quality.
accuracy_design.uncertainty: Training seeds are crossed with VAL parents. Average paired candidate-minus-baseline deltas across the fixed predeclared seeds within each independent original parent, then resample complete parents. Report seed variation separately. Use simultaneous one-sided95% Bonferroni-adjusted paired-parent bootstrap lower bounds across the full declared co-endpoint family, orienting every endpoint so positive means improvement. Every required lower bound must be >=0; unavailable endpoints make the no-sacrifice claim inconclusive. Five original VAL parents limit precision; no intervals/focals treated as independent.
accuracy_design.selection: Use VAL only for the predeclared candidate decision. Accuracy preservation requires all zero-margin gates, including original dense boundary/calibration support where required. If a required endpoint is unavailable, do not claim no sacrifice. Keep TEST sealed. Retain negative development diagnostics; do not expand search after outcomes without prospective registration.

efficiency_gate.objective: A practical wall-time improvement at the agreed accuracy gate with unchanged original data support and a feasible complete-parent memory budget.
efficiency_gate.throughput: Report native nodes, native intervals, sites and original supervised focals per second plus total update wall time; no fabricated duplicate work.
efficiency_gate.utilization: Report useful kernel activity and GPU duty over complete updates, together with stalls and transfer costs. The owner's >=80% target is not satisfied by nvidia-smi alone or by adding redundant computation.
efficiency_gate.adoption: Do not replace the current exact path unless the full-parent resource, accuracy and wall-time gates all pass. If the exact implementation already meets the objective, candidate novelty alone is insufficient.

no_actions_performed: No live model, checkpoint, worker or job modification
